archival_memory.user_quote_5: At the end of the day, success isn't just about what you achieve—it's about what you sustain. Anyone can have a good year, make a big deal, or get lucky once. I've met people who made millions overnight and lost it just as quickly because they never built the habits to sustain it. The real key? And growth is the only real indicator of lasting success.
